events.title: In association football , 맨체스터 시티 beat rivals 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 in the FA Cup final at Wembley Stadium in London to win their seventh FA Cup title. 일카이 귄도안 breaks the record for the fastest goal in an FA Cup final, scoring after just 12 seconds. (BBC Sport)

바르셀로나 Femení win their second UEFA Women's Champions League title after defeating VfL 볼프스부르크 3–2 in the final at the Philips Stadion in Eindhoven , Netherlands . Fridolina Rolfö scored the winner after 바르셀로나 had trailed 2–0 at the break. (Al Jazeera)

In association football , 웨스트햄 유나이티드 defeat 피오렌티나 2–1 at the Fortuna Arena in Prague , Czech Republic , to win the 2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League and qualify for the group stage of the 2023–24 UEFA Europa League . (BBC Sport)

In association football , 맨체스터 시티 win their first UEFA Champions League title with a 1–0 victory over 인테르 in the final at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul , Turkey , with Rodri scoring the winner. Having also won the Premier League and FA Cup that season, City become the second English club to complete the continental treble after rivals 맨체스터 유나이티드 in 1999 . (CNN) ( The Guardian )

In association football , Uruguay win their first FIFA U-20 World Cup title with a 1–0 victory over Italy in the final at the Estadio Único in La Plata , Argentina . Italy's 체사레 카사데이 is awarded the tournament's Golden Ball . (AP)
In association football , Nicaragua is banned from the 2023 CONCACAF Gold Cup for fielding an ineligible player for eight matches and will be replaced by Trinidad and Tobago . (CBS Sports)

In association football , Spain defeat Croatia 5–4 on penalties , after a 0–0 draw, in the final held at the De Kuip in Rotterdam , Netherlands , to win their first UEFA Nations League championship. (BBC)

In association football, the United States defeat Canada 2–0 in the final held at Allegiant Stadium in Paradise , Nevada , United States, to win their second CONCACAF Nations League championship. 크리스천 풀리식 is named the tournament's " best player ". (AP via The Indian Express )

The New Zealand national team abandon their friendly against Qatar at half-time in protest at a Qatari player's alleged use of a racial slur against New Zealand defender 마이클 복설 , who is half Samoan . (CNN)
